name: Simo
quote: The melting snow follows the warmth of the sun.

voices.label: Good Morning
voices.text: Good morning, Professor.

voices.label: Good Afternoon
voices.text: It's a beautiful afternoon. Sako is full of energy, too.

voices.label: Good Evening
voices.text: Do you have any special missions for me tonight?

voices.label: Good Night
voices.text: It's already dark outside. Are you still working, Professor?

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 1
voices.text: Professor, have you seen Sako? I took my eyes off him for a second, and he ran off.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 2
voices.text: I watched a movie yesterday. It's about a robot searching for the meaning of its own existence... Would you like to watch it with me sometime, Professor?

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 3
voices.text: Has the Professor fallen asleep? ... I better keep quiet then.

voices.label: Home Screen 5
voices.text: My bow gun has been adjusted to perfection. Should we go hunting inside the sector?

voices.label: Interactive Voice 1
voices.text: Is there a problem, Professor?

voices.label: Interactive Voice 2
voices.text: You want to see Sako? Please give me a minute.

voices.label: Interactive Voice 3
voices.text: Hmm...

voices.label: On Duty
voices.text: I'll take care of it.

voices.label: Obtain
voices.text: My name is Simo. Thank you, Professor, for giving me a place to stay. I hope I can be of some help to your future endeavors.

voices.label: Potential Breakthrough
voices.text: My sight and sense of smell have become sharper.

voices.label: Neural Expansion
voices.text: Like a lone arctic wolf, a good sniper must be able to conceal their presence in snow.

voices.label: Max Rank
voices.text: To survive on the battlefield, technique, energy, and a goal are essential. I've already got all of those. That last one especially—at least I think I know what I'm supposed to do.

voices.label: Join Team
voices.text: Simo here, ready for battle.

voices.label: Battle Start
voices.text: I can smell the enemy's presence.

voices.label: Ultimate Skill
voices.text: The hunt is on.

voices.label: MVP 1
voices.text: Target eliminated.

voices.label: MVP 2
voices.text: No arrows missed.

voices.label: Defeat
voices.text: No... Is this the end of me?

voices.label: Oath
voices.text: Honestly, I am a little shocked. I may need some time to clear my head... But I'm really happy that you shared your feelings with me. I won't have to feel so alone anymore, or beat myself up for feeling worthless or defective. Not only that, but you have also given me a place to stay. I'm looking forward to our future together, Professor.

voices.label: New Year
voices.text: A new year has arrived... May there be a brighter future in store for us. Do you have any wishes for the new year, Professor?

voices.label: Valentine's Day
voices.text: Please don't mind the footprints and claw marks on this chocolate, that's Sako's doing... I had to scramble a bit to pull this one off, but I hope you'll accept my gift nonetheless. I'll try to be better prepared if there is another opportunity in the future.

voices.label: Tanabata
voices.text: There aren't many things more beautiful than the Northern Lights... other than a sky full of stars and the Milky Way perhaps. I didn't expect to see such a spectacular view in Magrasea. What a pleasant surprise.

voices.label: Halloween
voices.text: Hmmm... I'm not a big fan of trick or treating, but I did prepare some candy for the occasion. Of course, I've got some for you and Sako, too.

voices.label: Christmas
voices.text: Merry Christmas, Professor. Seeing this splendidly decorated Christmas tree and the pure white snow... All of these memories are flooding back...

voices.label: Birthday Wish
voices.text:
Since it's your birthday today, Sako and I made you some breakfast.
Karjalan Piirakka is a common dish in Scandinavia. First you take some mashed potatoes and boil them in milk, then you take that along with some crushed nuts and meat and stuff it all inside a crust that's made with rye dough. Bake it until it's fully cooked, then cover it in cheese sauce. You've never had this before, right, Professor? Give it a try, I think you will like it.

voices.label: Neural Cloud
voices.text: Neural Cloud

voices.label: Intimacy 1
voices.text: Have you ever had a pet before, Professor? It can be a lot of work, but it's very fulfilling as well. It helps alleviate stress and loneliness too. Right, Sako? Huh? He's gone again...

voices.label: Intimacy 2
voices.text: Here... This is a picture I took two years ago when I was on a mission. Look, it's the Northern Lights. The turquoise beams of lights floating in the night sky like streams of silk... few sights in the world could compare to such beauty. Unfortunately, the scenery was perhaps the only thing beautiful about that place.

voices.label: Intimacy 3
voices.text:
Every person has a place in their heart that they'd prefer to keep hidden from others. The same can be said about us Dolls, of course.
Please excuse me, Professor, but I cannot answer that question yet. Maybe I will change my mind in time...

voices.label: Intimacy 4
voices.text:
"Crimson blood slowly flowing on top of pure white snow." Now you know everything about those experiences I was trying to hide before.
People got injured and people died. There were countless moments where I was caught between life and death, and in those moments, my heart was filled with fear as I questioned the meaning of my existence.

voices.label: Intimacy 5
voices.text:
Perhaps it is easier to put it into words than keeping everything to myself.
Thank you, Professor. For listening to my feelings and the stories of my past. I shall put the past behind me and move forward, for there is still a long road ahead of us.

career:
The Gaul is an extremely expensive special forces Doll developed by Svarog Heavy Industries. They are equipped with a sniper crossbow, state-of-the-art optics, optical camouflage, and other advanced equipment. These make them adept in launching covert long-ranged attacks and information-gathering operations.

After leaving the factory, Simo was purchased by a special forces group whose name was left secret. While in the employ of this unit, he perfectly completed several military missions, earning him the title of "Pale Ghost". Later, the unit returned him to Svarog Heavy Industries, citing "defects related to programming; unsuitable for long-term combat". Simo was then sent to 42Lab to participate in Project Neural Cloud.
infoStories:
[Log Code 20540806947565]

Simo, Model: Gaul, Serial No: 01052448.
Authority Code: Gannicus71. Affiliated Unit: ——

Initial Awakening Confirmed. Initial Calibration Confirmed. Initial Authority Handover Confirmed. Simo is Online.

Matched mission Z5-01 requirements, transferred. Task Category: Single Target Elimination. Task Target: Leader of armed forces group "Two-Faced God", Active-Duty Lieutenant Colonel of the National Defense Army, Yuma Kozlov...

Supervisor's Note:
Even though the mission target was equipped with both Cyclopes and Azure Defense, Gaul still finished him in one strike. The entire mission was completed in just 5 days and he displayed combat efficiency much higher than that of human soldiers. It is recommended to increase Gaul's evaluation level to 2 and add them to the level 2 monitoring list.

Supervisor's Signature:
Gaul Supervisor: O116

[Log Code 205502052578463]

Simo, Model: Gaul, Serial No: 01052448.
Authority Code: Gannicus71. Affiliated Unit: ——

G3-33 Task File Handover. Task Category: Emergency Conflict. Mission Location: Gorsk Region.

Description of Target's Behavior and Suggestions [Only Fill-In for Monitoring Targets Level 2+]:
The mission was still completed smoothly. The target area was completely suppressed within 7 hours and 43 enemy soldiers were killed. Physical damage to Gaul is low and his Neural Cloud was merely distorted for a short period. The emergency psychological mechanism has already been activated to deal with the after-effects.

Supervisor's Note:
Gorsk was suddenly attacked by government forces and we were forced to dispatch the nearby Gaul to deal with it. However, this was a good opportunity for testing. It is now certain that under the influence of ██ procedures, Gaul can presently only quickly complete single target elimination tasks. In the short-term, accepting team-level conflict missions may damage the Neural Cloud. I have followed the lieutenant's suggestions and have ██ Gaul's neural system. Whether it will affect his combat efficiency will need to wait for further observation.

Supervisor's Signature:
Gaul Supervisor: O116

[Log Code 205508145347896]

Simo. Model: Gaul. Serial No: 01052448.
Authority Code: Gannicus71. Affiliated Unit: ——

G3-33 Task File Handover. Task Category: Take Over Enemy Stronghold. Mission Location: Karelia Region.

Description of Target's Behavior and Suggestions [Only Fill-In for Monitoring Targets Level 2+]:
The mission was completed successfully. The enemy stronghold was conquered within 3 days and 131 enemy soldiers were killed. Physical damage to Gaul is moderate and his Neural Cloud was severely disturbed. The emergency psychological mechanism has already been activated to deal with the after-effects.

Supervisor's Note:
The combat record of the past six months is proof of the genius of the lieutenant's idea. Only under long-term neural overload will Gaul's combat ability decrease slightly. Compared to the benefit of continuous combat, this is a negligible consideration. As long as his data is constantly monitored and the ██ commands are remotely executed, we can ensure that Gaul will successfully complete his big tasks. This truly is a gift from above, and it is time for us to use this advantage to take back what is ours. To restore the glory of ██...

Supervisor's Signature:
Gaul Supervisor: O116

[Log Code 205802052578464]

Simo. Model: Gaul. Serial No: 01052448.
Authority Code: Gannicus71. Affiliated Unit: ——

Neural Cloud Intervention Process Has Been Activated—WARNING: Encountered an Error During the Process. Please Report This Error To A Supervisor.
......
Serial No: 01052448 Confirm End Monitoring. Ending the Monitoring Process...

Description of Target's Behavior and Suggestions [Only Fill In for Monitoring Targets Level 2+]:
 ████████

Supervisor's Note:
It appears that the ██ command causes some irreversible damage to the Dolls Neural Cloud System. Still, in terms of cost-effectiveness, Gaul's performance far exceeded expectations. I have already found a contact at Svarog Heavy Industries and will proceed with returning Gaul according to their regulations. They will also refund part of the cost. From here on out, I will sort out the proposal to purchase the next batch of military Dolls and submit it with the report...

Supervisor's Signature:
Gaul Supervisor: O116

[Svarog Heavy Industries Return Record—Svarog Military EE Department 03 Research Group]

Simo. Model: Gaul. Serial No: 01052448.
Authority Code: Gannicus71. 

Records show that Gaul was purchased by an organization from Eastern Europe in 2054 under an individual's name. Gaul was relieved of duties in February 2058 and formally returned the following month.

Neural system examination revealed that Simo's malfunction was due to the excessive use of the ██ command. According to feedback from the supervisor, the performance of the ██ program is not ideal in real-world situations. It is recommended to adjust the direction of follow-up research and development in related projects. To protect our client's privacy, we have not made any changes to Simo's existing neural system. We will make further arrangements for his future based on his performance after his recovery and the wishes of their supervisor.

Supervisor Notes:
Although Gaul has some defects, their combat data is absolutely critical and it is hoped that it can be used for further research and development of military Dolls. I look forward to our next cooperation with Svarog Heavy Industries' Military EE Department.

Supervisor's Signature:
Gaul Supervisor: O116
oathDesc: A cold, sharp bolt, clearing a path for the future you envision.

projections.name: Pale Ghost
projections.desc:
Attire produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea. These are the clothes they are most comfortable in.
"It was freezing cold on that battlefield in Eastern Europe. Nothing could be closer to death than that blank whiteness that surrounded him."

projections.desc:

projections.name: The Last Battle
projections.desc:
Attire and environment produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea, which mirrors their life in the real world.
"Running through the pale wilderness, his eyes are filled with determination."

skinList.name: Fool's Duality
skinList.desc:
The Dolls reveal their true natures by accident, and take new forms with the aid of a mysterious power. Where truth and falsehood intersect, beware of drowning in a fool's game.
"The past always follows you closely, like a spot of mud on the back of your tail, squeak..."

skinList.name: Wishing Projection
skinList.desc:
Warming fireworks fill the silent night, and as the embers fall, they transform into countless candleflames. This is the most beautiful scene that the Dolls left behind on a Qixi summer night.
"When we meet again in the world you're describing, let's sit on a balcony and drink soda again, like this."

skinList.name: Lustrous Broadway
skinList.desc:
"Splendid Evening" Series — To celebrate an incoming special day, the Doll in question prepared a truly dazzling outfit, giving this wondrous realm a unique hue of its very own.
The curtains aside, embellished staff in hand, ermine peeking out from beneath the hat's hems. Move not aside your eyes, for surprises are abound.
"Squeak-" "Looks like Sako's the same way as me, expecting your arrival. The night of magic is upon us. Are you ready?"
